ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious DLL Registered Via Odbcconf.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "REGSVR" action where the DLL in question doesn't contain a ".dll" extension. Which is often used as a method to evade defenses.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\odbcconf\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "odbcconf\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*REGSVR\\ .*")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll.*"))
